description: Enlarged simulation practice arena: photographed layout at twice the previous XY scale; robot dimensions are unchanged.

provenance.layout_reference: User-supplied arena photograph, 19 November 2026; image is not distributed in this package.
provenance.scale_status: SIM PRACTICE SCALE: length and width are doubled from the previous reconstruction at the user request. This is not a surveyed physical arena; supplied maps/week5 files retain their original scale.
reconstruction_notes: The source's 133 fragmented collision boxes are replaced by 13 continuous boxes with the same broad layout.
Double all arena-local XY geometry while retaining the world rotation and world-centre position; the neutral robot spawn stays at the same world pose.
Wall thickness scales from 0.15 m to 0.30 m in plan. Wall height remains 0.30 m; the robot model, sensor ranges and map resolution are unchanged.
The photograph establishes arrangement, not metric divider lengths: perspective alone does not establish whether the near dividers are longer.
The near-left L, three other side protrusions and open central corridor are retained.
No official coursework start, B1/B2/B3 entrance or fruit assignment is encoded.

world_from_arena.convention: world_xy = R(yaw_rad) * arena_xy + translation_m.xy; world_yaw = arena_yaw + yaw_rad

map.raster_policy: A cell is occupied if its closed square intersects any wall collision footprint. Exterior cells are unknown.
